intro: One piece of grilled chicken thigh is about 260 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the thigh meat and skin, with a little from the marinade.

breakdown.part: Honey, soy sauce and spice marinade

diet: Yes, ayam bakar is one of the best lauk for weight loss. High in protein and not much oil since it's not fried. Thigh has a bit more fat than breast, but it's still okay. Just watch the sauce and the rice portion beside it.
tips: Choose ayam bakar over ayam goreng at the nasi campur stall.
Dip in air asam or sambal kicap instead of sweet sauce.
Remove the skin to save about 60 kcal.

swap.name: Skinless grilled chicken breast
swap.why: Almost the same protein, with much less fat.

faq.q: Thigh or breast, which is better?
faq.a: Breast is lower in fat. Thigh is juicier and doesn't dry out as fast. Both are fine, depending on your calorie budget.

faq.q: How long should I marinate ayam bakar?
faq.a: At least 1 hour. Marinate overnight in the fridge for more flavour.

faq.q: Can I make ayam bakar in an air fryer?
faq.a: Yes. About 180°C for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway.
